title: Min Max Matrix
titleZh: 最大值的最小值，最小值的最大值
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

You are given positive integers $H$, $W$, and $M$.

Find the number, modulo $998244353$, of $H\times W$ matrices $A$, each of whose elements is an integer between $1$ and $M$ (inclusive), satisfying the following condition.

\[ \min_{1\le i\le H}\max_{1\le j\le W}A_{i,j}=\max_{1\le j\le W}\min_{1\le i\le H}A_{i,j} \]

Here, $A_{i,j}$ denotes the element at the $i$-th row and $j$-th column of matrix $A$.

## Constraints

- $1 \le H,W \le 200$
- $1 \le M \le 10^8$
- All input values are integers.

## Input

The input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
H W M
```

## Output

Output the answer.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

给定正整数 $H$、$W$ 和 $M$。

求满足以下条件的 $H\times W$ 矩阵 $A$ 的数量，对 $998244353$ 取模。矩阵中的每个元素都是 $1$ 到 $M$（含）之间的整数。

\[ \min_{1\le i\le H}\max_{1\le j\le W}A_{i,j}=\max_{1\le j\le W}\min_{1\le i\le H}A_{i,j} \]

这里，$A_{i,j}$ 表示矩阵 $A$ 中第 $i$ 行、第 $j$ 列的元素。

## 约束条件

- $1 \le H,W \le 200$
- $1 \le M \le 10^8$
- 输入的所有数值均为整数。

## 输入格式

输入从标准输入按以下格式给出：

```
H W M
```

## 输出格式

输出答案。

samples.note:
For example, $A=\begin{pmatrix} 1 & 2\\ 2 & 3\end{pmatrix}$ satisfies the condition.

- $\displaystyle\min_{1\le i\le H}\max_{1\le j\le W}A_{i,j}=\max_{1\le j\le W}\min_{1\le i\le H}A_{i,j}=2$ holds.

On the other hand, $A=\begin{pmatrix} 1 & 3\\ 3 & 2\end{pmatrix}$ does not satisfy the condition.

- $\displaystyle\min_{1\le i\le H}\max_{1\le j\le W}A_{i,j}=3,\max_{1\le j\le W}\min_{1\le i\le H}A_{i,j}=2$.

There are $67$ matrices $A$ satisfying the condition.
